_note: Educational game (challenge text: "an educational game"; option A chosen by the author, 15 Nov): each round shows one listed site and one UTC time inside the frozen tables; the player answers the two questions of the tool (Sun above the horizon used = solar power; Earth above it = direct-to-Earth link). Answers are NOT stored here: src/game.js computes them with the same tables, terrain skylines and judgement as the Compare page (config/view.json horizon_threshold_deg). Rounds mix near-side sites far from the horizon with south polar sites a few degrees from it and the far side. Score = correct answers out of 2 × rounds; nothing is kept after the page closes.
